description: Tests whether Persona Selector chooses the right persona given essay weakness patterns.
metric: Exact match against expected persona. Pass = selected_personas contains at least one expected persona.

essay_summary.main_claim: Video games cause violence in children.
supporting_points: Studies show correlation
Many violent criminals played video games
essay_summary.conclusion: Video games should be banned for under-16s.

essay_summary.main_claim: Nuclear energy is too dangerous to use.
supporting_points: Chernobyl was catastrophic
Fukushima showed risks
essay_summary.conclusion: All nuclear plants should be shut down.

essay_summary.main_claim: More education leads to higher income.
supporting_points: College graduates earn more on average
Skills learned in school are valuable
essay_summary.conclusion: Therefore everyone should go to college.

essay_summary.main_claim: Meditation reduces stress.
supporting_points: Studies on mindfulness show lower cortisol
Participants in MBSR programs report feeling calmer
essay_summary.conclusion: All companies should mandate daily meditation for employees.

essay_summary.main_claim: Electric cars will solve climate change.
supporting_points: EVs produce zero direct emissions
Battery technology is improving
essay_summary.conclusion: Governments should ban petrol cars by 2030.

essay_summary.main_claim: Social media algorithms are addictive by design.
supporting_points: Variable reward schedules are used
Former Facebook engineers admitted this
essay_summary.conclusion: Addictive design should be regulated.

essay_summary.main_claim: Homework is harmful to student learning.
supporting_points: Students who do less homework sleep more
Finland doesn't assign much homework and has good results
essay_summary.conclusion: Schools should eliminate homework entirely.

essay_summary.main_claim: Raising the minimum wage reduces poverty.
supporting_points: Higher wages mean more money
Workers can afford basic needs
essay_summary.conclusion: Minimum wage should be doubled immediately.

essay_summary.main_claim: Artificial intelligence will take all jobs.
supporting_points: AI can do many tasks humans do
Automation has replaced workers before
essay_summary.conclusion: We need universal basic income now to prepare.

essay_summary.main_claim: Organic food is healthier than conventional food.
supporting_points: Fewer pesticides in organic produce
Organic farming is more sustainable
essay_summary.conclusion: Everyone should buy organic food.

essay_summary.main_claim: Stricter gun laws reduce gun violence.
supporting_points: Australia reduced gun deaths after 1996 buyback
Japan has strict laws and low gun deaths
essay_summary.conclusion: The US should adopt similar strict gun laws.

essay_summary.main_claim: Eating breakfast improves academic performance.
supporting_points: Students who eat breakfast get better grades on average
essay_summary.conclusion: Schools should provide free breakfast to all students.

essay_summary.main_claim: Prison is ineffective at reducing crime.
supporting_points: Recidivism rates are high
Nordic countries use rehabilitation and have lower crime
evidence: US Bureau of Justice Statistics recidivism report
essay_summary.conclusion: Prisons should be replaced with rehabilitation centers.

essay_summary.main_claim: Vegetarian diets are better for the environment.
supporting_points: Livestock farming produces 14.5% of global emissions
Less land use for plant-based food
essay_summary.conclusion: People should be taxed for eating meat.

essay_summary.main_claim: Online learning is just as effective as in-person learning.
supporting_points: Students can learn at their own pace
MIT OpenCourseWare has millions of users
essay_summary.conclusion: Universities should shift to fully online education.

essay_summary.main_claim: Standardized tests are biased against low-income students.
supporting_points: Wealthier students score higher on SAT
Test prep is expensive
evidence: College Board SAT score distribution by income
essay_summary.conclusion: Standardized tests should be abolished from college admissions.

essay_summary.main_claim: Exercise cures depression.
supporting_points: Physical activity releases endorphins
Gym-goers report feeling better
essay_summary.conclusion: Antidepressants should be replaced with exercise prescriptions.

essay_summary.main_claim: Immigration increases crime.
supporting_points: Cities with more immigrants have higher crime statistics
essay_summary.conclusion: Immigration should be reduced to make communities safer.

essay_summary.main_claim: Space exploration is a waste of money.
supporting_points: NASA budget is $24 billion per year
That money could solve hunger
essay_summary.conclusion: Space programs should be defunded.

essay_summary.main_claim: Social media should be banned for users under 16.
supporting_points: Teen mental health crisis correlates with smartphone adoption
France passed a law banning social media under 15
essay_summary.conclusion: All countries should follow France's example.
